name: Toumei Koiito
source:
"What meaning is left in life when your reason for living disappears?"

On the morning of March 14, 
16-year old Amano Shizuka's life teeters on the brink of ruin
when she lost her most cherished person
-the light of her life-
to the clutches of death.

Her heart falls into a frigid winter
while flowers all around her begin to bloom to greet the incoming spring.

Shizuka, however, isn't the only one who seems to have been forsaken by spring's joy.

A younger sibling takes on more burden than he was supposed to originally bear.
A twin dedicates his life to another's happiness, forgetting to live his own.
A genius, as if cursed, keeps chasing afterimages of the past.
An orphan finds less and less meaning in life with each passing day.

As if bound by a thread unseen by the eyes, Shizuka and these people's paths tangled.

Will she choose to grab hold of these threads?
Or will she choose to let go?

[From [url=https://spicastudios.itch.io/toumei-koiito-demo] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「當活著的理由消失後，生命還剩下什麼意義？」

3月14日早晨，16歲的天野靜香失去了最珍愛的人——生命中的光芒被死神奪走——她的人生懸於毀滅邊緣。她的內心陷入嚴冬，而周圍的花朵紛紛綻放，迎接即將到來的春天。

然而，似乎不只靜香被春日的喜悅拋棄。一個年幼的弟弟承擔了原本不該由他承擔的重負；一名雙胞胎將一生獻給另一個人的幸福，卻忘了自己也要活下去；一名天才彷彿受到詛咒，不斷追逐過去的殘影；一名孤兒則一天天感到人生越來越沒有意義。

彷彿被肉眼看不見的絲線牽引，靜香與這些人的道路交織在一起。她會選擇抓住這些絲線，還是選擇放手？
